title: V2 Flow Blue

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Fox Racing V2 Flow Blue is delivers competition-grade off-road impact absorption with maximum cooling throughput, pairing extreme cooling throughput with competition-grade roost protection. Built around a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell weighing 1433g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~100 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.05 benchmarks. An ultra-breathable, antimicrobial interior liner stabilizes the helmet during aggressive terrain vibration, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Mid-range MX with MIPS brain protection system and fiberglass shell.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Fox Racing V2 Flow Blue is a motocross/dirt bike helmet designed for off-road racing. It features an open-face design typical of MX helmets, optimized for ventilation and lightweight performance on dirt tracks.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Fox Racing V2 Flow Blue: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Fox Racing's Dirt / MX lineup, the V2 Flow Blue brings American engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Fox Racing V2 Flow Blue represents Fox Racing's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~100 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Performance Fiberglass Composite (HPFC) Dirt / MX helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Fox Racing V2 Flow Blue delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
